Travel 1 tile to grove.
— Nut trees —
The canopy here is a roof built by a thousand architects who never met. Light comes through in coins.

📓 Journal: you UNDERSTAND Green Thumb, Literally. It resonates with: something unnamed, something unnamed.

A shot in the dark — you take what's green: 5× unknown berries, 5× unknown berries, 9× unknown nuts. Into the bag, unnamed. (Not food until identified — sort them at camp.) This patch is picked clean — it'll recover in a few days.

Travel 2 tiles to creek.
— Moving water —
Water over stone, loud enough to cover your noise. You could drink here without announcing it.
Movement — a small fish flashing in the water.
👁 One splash and it's gone. Corner it away from the water.
This patch is worked out — step to another green patch and forage again.

Travel 2 tiles to creek.
— Moving water —
A kingfisher works the far bank, patient as a tax collector. It catches something silver and is gone before you can envy it properly.
Something moves out there — stripes resolving out of the bamboo, watching you.
You see smoke on the horizon. Ashford — 10 people, 1 day in. fishing folk, by the look of it. They know 2 plants — 2 new to you. They've been here the whole time.
Some of these unknown berries are starting to look familiar — sort them at camp in good light and the name might come to you.
You also take some vine (crafting material).

The stripes resolving out of the bamboo stops at the treeline — pacing, unwilling. The walls end the argument. It's still out there.
You keep a day's food (1400 kcal) — nothing extra for the pantry this time.
2 unprocessed hauls onto the counter — the clock is ticking.
Someone by the fire nods at the counter. "We pool food here. Keep what you need for the road — the rest feeds everyone, once it's food."
Nobody at the fire knows your haul any better than you do. It'll be your own hands that teach you.
You walk back into Haven. 3 Codex entries. The village is glad to see you.
